source.name: RBI Handbook 2022-23, Table 35 — Implementation of Central Sector Projects
RBI Handbook 2022-23, Table 36 — Cost Overrun of Delayed Central Sector Projects

metadata.label: Central-sector project implementation quality
metadata.methodology: Published project-status counts are converted to shares. Cost overrun is anticipated less original cost as a share of original cost. Sector histories remain in metadata for the interactive explorer.
metadata.note: Coverage is central-sector projects of ₹100 crore and above through 2010 and ₹150 crore and above from 2011. This stage measures monitored delivery quality, not the social return or construction quality of completed assets.
metadata.break_note: From 2011 the threshold rose from ₹100 crore to ₹150 crore and delay began to be measured against the original schedule.

projects_monitored.label: Projects monitored
projects_monitored.methodology: Central sector projects in the published monitoring universe.
projects_monitored.source_note: The monitoring threshold and delay definition changed in 2011; levels are descriptive, not a causal performance ranking.

on_schedule_share.label: Ahead or on-schedule projects
on_schedule_share.methodology: Share of monitored projects in the stated delivery category.
on_schedule_share.source_note: The monitoring threshold and delay definition changed in 2011; levels are descriptive, not a causal performance ranking.

delayed_share.label: Delayed projects
delayed_share.methodology: Share of monitored projects in the stated delivery category.
delayed_share.source_note: The monitoring threshold and delay definition changed in 2011; levels are descriptive, not a causal performance ranking.

without_date_share.label: Projects without commissioning date
without_date_share.methodology: Share of monitored projects in the stated delivery category.
without_date_share.source_note: The monitoring threshold and delay definition changed in 2011; levels are descriptive, not a causal performance ranking.

cost_overrun_pct.label: Cost overrun of delayed projects
cost_overrun_pct.methodology: Anticipated less original cost, divided by original cost, for delayed projects.
cost_overrun_pct.source_note: The monitoring threshold and delay definition changed in 2011; levels are descriptive, not a causal performance ranking.
